config.name: BoonData.json
config.summary: Game-balance data defining selectable boons (perks), each with a code, localized name/description string keys, a 5-bit position mask, and five tunable value slots. Loaded at runtime by DataManager into boon data structures.

config.name: DefineData.json
config.summary: Global gameplay constants (define table) holding the player's default HP, default damage, and default round timer values. Loaded at runtime by DataManager as base tuning parameters.

config.name: DeviationData.json
config.summary: Game-balance data defining deviation entries (boon-shaped records with code, localized name/description keys, position mask, and five value slots) used as gameplay modifiers. Loaded at runtime by DataManager.

config.name: EnemyData.json
config.summary: Enemy roster of ten enemy types, each with a code, localized string keys, a resource/prefab name, the min/max round range in which it can appear, and three tunable value slots. Loaded at runtime by DataManager to drive enemy spawning.

config.name: RoundData.json
config.summary: Per-round difficulty curve for ten rounds, defining a cumulative round-timer delta and an enemy HP multiplier that scales from 1.0 up to 4.0. Loaded at runtime by DataManager to ramp difficulty across rounds.

config.name: manifest.json
config.summary: Unity Package Manager manifest declaring the project's direct package dependencies and registry configuration.

config.name: packages-lock.json
config.summary: Unity Package Manager lockfile pinning resolved versions, sources, and dependency hashes for reproducible package restoration.

list.name: Core & Infrastructure
list.description: The App service-locator/bootstrap, project-wide enums, and shared helpers (JSON parsing, RPS judging, frame monitoring) that every other layer depends on.

list.name: Managers
list.description: App-driven singleton and per-scene managers (network, player, lobby, in-game, data, asset, sound, input, title) plus their ManagerBase/SceneManagerBase/UIManagerBase base classes that orchestrate the game's subsystems.

list.name: Networking
list.description: Photon Fusion lobby and session objects: the [Networked] PlayerNetworkObject, session/player state models, result wrappers, and lobby-code utilities for real-time multiplayer.

list.name: Gameplay
list.description: Core RPS gameplay domain: player/enemy hands, fingers, hand-sprite data, game-mode flags, and the HP-bar visual effect that drive match logic.

list.name: UI & Presentation
list.description: uGUI panels and reusable slot/modal widgets for the title, lobby, and in-game HUD, all built on the PanelBase lifecycle hub that self-registers with the UI managers.

list.name: Editor Tooling
list.description: Unity Editor utility windows for generating HandSpriteData ScriptableObjects from JSON and for fast scene launching during development.

list.name: Game Data & Project Config
list.description: Game-balance JSON tables (boon, define, deviation, enemy, round) consumed by DataManager, Unity package manifests, and the CLAUDE.md project guideline document.

file:Assets/02.
